name: Koumori Ryo
source:
"In the end, the coward survives..."

Super high school level interpreter. He has overcome many obstacles to obtain such a title, but his method has always been the same: clinging to the strong. He himself is aware that it is cowardly, but he rationalizes that it was an inevitable choice every time. As much as he is proficient in 50 languages, so is his basic brain.

He belongs to the fairly good side, and although he has lived a cowardly life, there is no doubt that his talent as an interpreter is recognized by others.

He usually enjoys wearing a suit and shows a sluggishness that sticks around here and there during the work.
